claims.text: The source reuses text-to-image appearance/text alignment and learns motion from unlabeled video: text-to-image UNet extended with pseudo-3D convolutions (2D pretrained plus 1D identity-initialised) and pseudo-3D attention (spatial pretrained plus temporal zero/identity-initialised) plus fps conditioning; inference runs prior to 16x64x64 temporal decoder to masked interpolation (76 frames) to temporal+spatial super-resolution (shared noise); image prior trained on 2.3B filtered pairs with prior frozen, motion on videos-only sets.

Reported numbers: MSR-VTT zero-shot 16x256x256 all 59,794 test captions FID 13.17 / CLIPSIM 0.3049 vs CogVideo-EN 23.59/0.2631; UCF-101 zero-shot 256px class-conditional IS 33.00 / FVD 367.23, finetuned IS 82.55 / FVD 81.25; human preference 76x256x256 vs prior video-diffusion work 84.38% quality / 78.13% faithfulness.
